findings.evidence: OpenCode now runs behind bubblewrap filesystem isolation with private runtime path variables removed; only the disposable workspace, credential home, and read-only system runtime are mounted.

Provider-owned .git metadata is never used for publication. Parent mirrors only worktree content into a fresh trusted publisher clone, disables hooks/config, and pushes from trusted metadata with --no-verify and force-with-lease.
Primary checkout synchronization now compares HEAD to head_before before and after fetch and refuses destructive reset on concurrent advancement; remote publication also uses exact force-with-lease.

Validation now uses the fallback runtime's already-correct cwd and derives a credential-free pinned GitHub origin locally, so empty validation env allowlist no longer omits required repository variables.
